problem_text:
A logistics company needs to select packages for a cargo shipment. The available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 10 m³, revenue $102
* Package 2: volume 37 m³, revenue $222
* Package 3: volume 18 m³, revenue $38
* Package 4: volume 25 m³, revenue $66
* Package 5: volume 49 m³, revenue $264
* Package 6: volume 11 m³, revenue $204
* Package 7: volume 15 m³, revenue $219
* Package 8: volume 49 m³, revenue $208
* Package 9: volume 9 m³, revenue $296
* Package 10: volume 41 m³, revenue $236
* Package 11: volume 40 m³, revenue $195
* Package 12: volume 3 m³, revenue $278
* Package 13: volume 15 m³, revenue $120
* Package 14: volume 33 m³, revenue $214
* Package 15: volume 32 m³, revenue $124
* Package 16: volume 37 m³, revenue $50
* Package 17: volume 35 m³, revenue $66
* Package 18: volume 10 m³, revenue $94
* Package 19: volume 20 m³, revenue $24
* Package 20: volume 21 m³, revenue $68
* Package 21: volume 9 m³, revenue $280
* Package 22: volume 40 m³, revenue $102

The cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 391 m³. Choose the combination of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
